en: Black-and-white image of a large cargo ship moored at an industrial dock. The vessel has multiple cranes and loading booms along its deck and a large funnel. Warehouses and harbor cranes line the quay behind it. The ship's bow bears the name "TYSON LYKES," and the side of the hull prominently displays the company name "LYKES LINES." The sea is calm in the foreground and the sky is overcast.
